name: Hook The Difference
transcript: Everyone can hear the difference between a room and a recording of that room. What sits in between decides it.
visualDescription: The live-duo frame fills the top two thirds, scaled complete to the frame width with a blurred, dimmed copy of itself filling the space above and below it. A slow Gimbal Micro-Movement drift keeps it alive. The Shivansh Electronics logo sits in the lower-right safe area, drawn plain.
textOnScreen: EVERYONE CAN HEAR / THE DIFFERENCE.  (Fraunces, ink)  ·  www.shivanshelectronics.in
sequential: Headline arrives line by line from below; the URL fades up last.
audioCoupled: The second headline line lands as the riser peaks.

name: The Old Trade Off
transcript: For years that meant two bad options. An interface that adds hiss to everything, or one priced out of reach.
visualDescription: The wide podcast room shown complete on its own blurred field, drifting slowly. Two short caption chips sit beneath it.
textOnScreen: ADDS HISS TO EVERYTHING  /  OR PRICED OUT OF REACH  (alert red)
sequential: The two chips arrive one after the other, each with a small settle.
audioCoupled: The chip snaps to its settled position on the impact.

name: One Engine Three Sizes
transcript: The MOTU M-Series ends that. Three interfaces — M2, M4, M6 — one identical engine, differing only in how much you record at once.
visualDescription: Each of the three front panels is held ALONE and WHOLE, centred, for roughly 2.2s in sequence — M2, then M4, then M6 — before all three stack vertically under one heading. Every panel is uncropped.
textOnScreen: ONE ENGINE. / THREE SIZES.  ·  labels: MOTU M2 2 IN / 2 OUT · MOTU M4 4 IN / 4 OUT · MOTU M6 6 IN / 4 OUT  ·  MOTU logo
sequential: Three solo holds in order, then the three assemble into a stacked column.
audioCoupled: One pop per panel arrival, three in total.
transition: Transform — the stacked column contracts into the chip motif of the next scene.

name: Shared Converter
transcript: Every model carries the same ESS Sabre32 Ultra converter, delivering a hundred and twenty decibels of dynamic range on its main outputs.
visualDescription: The two white-ground hero shots sit one above the other, each complete and uncropped on the light page. A counter climbs to 120 dB between them.
textOnScreen: ESS SABRE32 ULTRA  ·  120 dB  ·  DYNAMIC RANGE, MAIN OUTPUTS  ·  www.shivanshelectronics.in
sequential: Counter climbs 0 → 120; the two hero shots drift gently apart as it does.
soundTrigger: Correct.mp3 when the counter locks at 120.
audioCoupled: The number stops climbing exactly on the sound.

name: Shared Noise And Latency
transcript: The preamps measure minus one hundred and twenty-nine dBu of equivalent input noise. Round-trip latency is two and a half milliseconds.
visualDescription: The close cable/connector frame and the low-angle desk frame cross-dissolve, each complete on its own field. Two spec figures sit over the light page beneath them.
textOnScreen: −129 dBu EIN  ·  2.5 ms ROUND-TRIP  (96 kHz, 32-sample buffer)
sequential: The two figures count in one after the other.
audioCoupled: Each figure settles on its own sound.

name: Shared Metering
